title: Improper Validation of Integrity Check Value
cweTitle: Improper Validation of Integrity Check Value
description: Build or deployment configuration references container images by mutable tags such as latest instead of immutable digests.
remediation: Pin container images by immutable SHA-256 digest instead of mutable tags.
intendedVulnerabilityNotes: Mutable latest tags are used in container build/deployment configuration.
